Facts:
- Roller Coaster Corporation of America is a United States-based amusement ride manufacturer.
- In 1992, Roller Coaster Corporation of America completed its first major project, The Rattler at Six Flags Fiesta Texas.
- In 2000, Roller Coaster Corporation of America built Son of Beast at Kings Island, which opened as the world's tallest and first looping wooden coaster.
- Iron Rattler is a steel roller coaster at Six Flags Fiesta Texas in San Antonio, Texas.
- In 2013, Iron Rattler opened as a replacement for the wooden coaster The Rattler by adding new steel track on The Rattler's wooden support structure.
- The Iron Rattler conversion increased the vertical difference of the first drop from 124 feet to 171 feet and changed the drop angle to 81 degrees.
- The Iron Rattler modifications increased the train speed from 65 mph to 70 mph.
